chunks: And Rib'i narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:
Regarding His, Mighty and Majestic is He, saying
"Then let them complete their prescribed grooming rites."
He عليه السلام said: "It means trimming the mustache and the nails."

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, the source of the explanation
key_terms.تَفَثَهُمْ: their state of untidiness or grooming rites to be removed/completed during pilgrimage
key_terms.رِبْعِيٌّ: Rib'i, the narrator transmitting the report
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ: Muhammad ibn Muslim, a transmitter in the sanad

ai.seo_question: What does «ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ» mean in Surah al-Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the phrase «ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ» as referring to acts of grooming performed in the hajj context, specifically trimming the mustache and cutting the nails. It presents a concise tafsir from Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام linking the Qur'anic expression to concrete ritual practice.
